# Workday Illuminate Expands — Press Release (2025-09-16)

## HR AI Agents Named
1. **Business Process Copilot Agent** — "Automates the implementation, configuration, and set-up of new business processes"
2. **Case Agent** — "Automates administrative tasks to help reduce resolution times, increase operational efficiency"
3. **Document Intelligence for Contingent Labor Agent** — "Accelerates SOW creation, tracks obligations, and promotes alignment across contracts"
4. **Employee Sentiment Agent** — "Continuously analyzing employee feedback to provide insights and take action at scale"
5. **Job Architecture Agent** — "Automates the creation and management of job ladders to drive alignment, agility, and scalable growth"
6. **Performance Agent** — "Analyzes performance data from various enterprise applications to streamline reviews and recommend actions"

## Claimed Metrics (주의: 모두 Workday 자체 수치, 독립 검증 없음)
- **Contract Intelligence Agent**: "reduces contract execution time by 65%" + "accelerates sales cycles and supplier onboarding"
- **Frontline Agent**: "cuts time spent on managing staffing changes by up to 90%"
- **Financial Audit Agent**: "saves early access customers up to 900 hours per year"
- **Payroll Agent**: "enables compliance up to 4x faster"
- **Planning Agent**: "reduce data exploration and analysis by 30%, equaling around 100 hours per month"

**★ 주의**: 위 5개 metric 모두 **HR 에이전트가 아닌** 다른 카테고리(Contract/Finance) 에이전트의 수치. HR 에이전트 6종에 대한 수치는 press release에 전무.
